result_text:
Promotions now carry an optional `description`, and it comes back in all the listings you named plus the lookup by code. The full offline suite passes: 608 tests, 0 failures. I did not commit.

What changed:

- **`model/Promotion.java`**: added `description` as the last record component. It is null when none was given.
- **`service/PromotionService.java`**: new 6-argument `createPromotion(..., category, description)`. The existing 5-argument version delegates with no description, so existing callers are untouched. A blank description is stored as null, the same way a blank category is.
- **`DataStore.java`**: the insert writes the description, and every promotion query reads it. That covers the code lookup, active on a date, active in a region, by category, best for a category on a date, and unused in a period.
- **`src/main/resources/schema.sql`**: new nullable `description VARCHAR(200)` column on `promotion`.
- **`PromotionTest.java`**: new `keepsDescriptionInAllListings` test. It creates a SUMMER promotion with "Summer sale on all hardware" and checks the text in each listing and lookup, and checks that a promotion without one returns null.

Two choices to check:
- The description is the last argument of the new overload, not an earlier one.
- The demo data in `DemoScenario` has no descriptions, so existing promotions show none, as the task asked.
